name: AWS_IAM_Password_Policy_Report_2026.pdf
content:
AWS IAM Password Policy Export
Generated by AWS Identity & Access Management Config Scanner

MinimumPasswordLength: 14
RequireSymbols: true
RequireNumbers: true
RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
ExpirePasswords: false
MaxPasswordAge: 90
PasswordReusePrevention: 5
HardExpiry: false

MFA ENFORCEMENT SUMMARY:
- Active across 100% of IAM Console Users via Okta SSO.
- Root account MFA: Hardware FIDO2 YubiKey Active.
- Inactive credentials deactivated automatically after 60 days.

aiAnalysis.summary: Enforces 14-char min length, MFA requirement, and restricts reuse of previous 5 passwords in compliance with SOC 2 CC6.1.
recommendations: Maintain automated annual credential rotation drills.

name: Information_Security_Policy_v3.2.docx
content:
Corporate Information Security Policy - Section 4: Network & Cryptography
4.1 Perimeter Protection: All public endpoints must reside behind AWS WAF and CloudFront.
4.2 Data in Transit: TLS 1.2 or higher is mandatory for all inbound customer connections. Internal service-to-service communication within the VPC mesh uses mTLS.
4.3 Data at Rest: Sensitive customer data in PostgreSQL and S3 buckets is encrypted using AES-256 via AWS KMS customer-managed keys.

aiAnalysis.summary: Policy defines TLS 1.2+ requirement but requires explicit cipher suite constraint documentation for internal microservices.
gaps: Internal mTLS cipher suite whitelists need explicit documentation.
recommendations: Update section 4.2 with approved TLS 1.3 cipher suites.

citations.text: Section 4.2: TLS 1.2 or higher is mandatory for all inbound customer connections.
